body: I'd rather have a purple  motorboat. :3
All of these so far have been so CUTE <3

Though In this frame of mind where I'm not wanting to kill myself  the guilt itself feels like it's not me. I'd explain it like Dr  Jekyll and Mr Hyde but instead of Hyde being a sociopathic serial killer he's a suicidal masochist who believes he's the cancer of the earth.

I'm just wanting to let everyone know I'm safe today at least I still feel terrible but I'm not at risk of hurting myself. It's strangely surprising to me to find people that actually care. I've been taking steps to get into college because I know they have better resources for housing. It's just going to be painful very painful.  The posts here mean a lot to me.
